prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: compositional website design variant for the COVENANT protocol landing page
Primary request: Create a polished 1600x1000 flat desktop website mockup for COVENANT, inspired by the supplied approved Security Print Instrument reference, but as a new ledger-led composition. The page should feel like one continuous modern financial security document, not a set of cards.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed flat desktop website canvas, no browser chrome and no device frame. Ivory paper field inside a restrained midnight-navy security border.
Subject: A slim headline band near the top, followed by a dominant horizontal six-link evidence ledger spanning almost the full viewport. Place a large "5 USDC" external obligation at the far left edge, a circular "PROOF VERIFIED" seal at the central hinge, and a large "4 CTC" credit draw at the far right edge. The six causal links read left to right as one continuous instrument: "Obligation issued", "Payment observed", "Payment receipt", "Oracle attestation", "Proof attested", "Credit released". Use fine connecting rules, arrows, stamps, serial marks, and shared guilloche linework so all six links belong to one document.
Style/medium: High-fidelity flat website UI mockup with serious modern financial typography, precise editorial spacing, restrained security-print detailing, contemporary institutional design.
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape, intended output 1600x1000. Top navigation stays visible with "COVENANT" wordmark on the left, links "Protocol", "Evidence", "Risk", "Docs", and outlined action "View public evidence" on the right. Beneath it, use a slim headline band with the exact headline "Credit follows proof." and supporting text "Verified repayment evidence controls every draw." The evidence ledger is the main visual and occupies most of the viewport. Add a narrow bottom serial strip with "SERIAL NO. CVN 000082", "PROOF EPOCH 1842", "CHAIN FINALITY 32/32", and "PUBLIC · VERIFIED".
Color palette: Warm ivory, midnight navy, vivid cobalt blue, restrained oxblood red, and small mint green verification accents.
Materials/textures: Fine guilloche linework, microprint borders, serial-number ink, ledger rules, embossed-looking proof seal, subtle paper grain. Keep the overall treatment clean and modern, with security-print texture used as disciplined detail.
Text (verbatim): "COVENANT"; "Protocol"; "Evidence"; "Risk"; "Docs"; "View public evidence"; "Credit follows proof."; "Verified repayment evidence controls every draw."; "5 USDC"; "EXTERNAL OBLIGATION"; "PROOF VERIFIED"; "4 CTC"; "CREDIT DRAW"; "Obligation issued"; "Payment observed"; "Payment receipt"; "Oracle attestation"; "Proof attested"; "Credit released"; "SERIAL NO. CVN 000082"; "PROOF EPOCH 1842"; "CHAIN FINALITY 32/32"; "PUBLIC · VERIFIED".
Constraints: Preserve clear navigation and the public evidence action. Keep the full six-link ledger legible as one causal chain. Flat orthographic web composition only. No separate card grid.
Avoid: card grid, vintage overload, ornamental clutter, coins, token illustrations, charts, dashboards, neon, gradients that feel synthetic, glassmorphism, 3D perspective, device mockups, browser frame, people, photography, watermark.
